messages.text:
The implementation file itself also needs the server suffix because it is re-exported.

I’m renaming the core files to `.server.ts` too, so every path that contains Node SQLite is visibly server-only.

commands.commandLine: "C:\\Program Files\\PowerShell\\7\\pwsh.exe" -Command "Rename-Item -LiteralPath src\\server\\db-core.ts -NewName db-core.server.ts; Rename-Item -LiteralPath src\\server\\api-core.ts -NewName api-core.server.ts"
commands.preview: Rename-Item -LiteralPath src\\server\\db-core.ts -NewName db-core.server.ts; Rename-Item -LiteralPath src\\server\\api-core.ts -NewName api-core.server.ts
